raw_segments.text: But the Kentuckians scorns not only labor, but all the undertakings which labor promotes.
As he lives in an idle independence, his tastes are those of an idle man.
Money loses a portion of its value in his eyes.
He covets wealth much less than pleasure and excitement.
And the energy which his neighbor devotes to gain turns with him to a passionate love
of field sports and military exercises.
He delights in violent, bodily exertion.
